item.description: - The Unread tab groups each day's items by pull request. A group header folds. On hover, it opens the pull request or marks all of its items read. - Each row shows a link button on hover and has "Copy Link" in its right-click menu. Unread items copy the link to the comment or review. Group headers copy the link to the pull request. - Each group header in the Mine tab has a control that folds all of its repositories. When all are folded, it unfolds them.
